title: Multi-Camera 3D Pose Pipeline
description: Research pipeline at UCSD's HECD Lab: YOLOv8 pose estimation across 6 synchronized cameras, OSNet re-identification across views, and DLT triangulation into 3D joint trajectories.

title: SolarSentinel
description: Real-time solar anomaly detection: an XGBoost model on AWS SageMaker scoring 50 solar installs every 5 minutes, with live alerts on a React dashboard.

title: TritonPass
description: BLE-powered student networking app built with React Native, a Node.js/Express backend, PostgreSQL and real-time messaging.

title: DSC 106 Portfolio Website
description: This site: built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript across the DSC 106 labs, with a JS-generated nav, dark mode and project data loaded from JSON.

title: Statistics Practice Problem Sets
description: Original practice problems on hypothesis testing, distributions and regression, written as a Supplemental Instructor at Golden West College.
